summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (public loader plus private _resolve_path helper, stdlib only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined autofunction entry after Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist containing four tests. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. Line lengths were measured: no line over 120 columns in the new or changed Python files. Black was not run, so black-cleanliness is unverified by tool. Choices beyond the spec: non-object top-level JSON and non-list data-list values raise ValueError; missing image/label fields are skipped without error.
